notes: Posted 30 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (8)': Set Your Course For Alderaan, Death Star, Death Star Docking Bay, Alderaan, Prepared Defenses, TINT/OE, Secret Plans, Mobilization Points; they count toward the 60. Prepared Defenses brings three Effects (There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement, Secret Plans, Mobilization Points), so no single starting effect is set.

The poster's edit is applied: 'There should be an x4 next to the SFS Laser Cannons and it should read Scythe Sq. TIEs, not Scimitar' - so 4 SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannons and 2 Scythe Squadron TIE. With the edit the sections add up (Weapons (5)) and the total is 60.
A later 'card change by popular request' (out Death Star Gunner and Superlaser, in Flawless Marksmanship x2) is not applied; the list is kept as posted.
Dark pages dested for the dual-printed sites: Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark), Alderaan (Dark), Endor (Dark), Kashyyyk (Dark), Sullust (Dark).

Posted 'TINT/OE' dested There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; 'A Bright Center Of The Universe' dested A Bright Center To The Universe; 'Dreadnaught' dested Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'U-3PO' dested U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio).
Posted 'Grabber' is unnamed and kept as written.
Secret Plans and There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement are 2001 Effects (not Defensive Shields).
The strategy says the deck went 3-0 and took first place at an unnamed local tournament; no event is named, so it stays a general deck.
